scope: Human-controlled collection source editing and exact-version native review/apply orchestration joined to conversation and model-disabled manual controls
implementation: Only an explicit editor selection parses an observed model reply as a complete closed collection source; no automatic parsing, code-fence removal, inferred membership, latest-version resolution or model authority

Bounded full-source replacement, name/member edits, actual native contract preview, explicit independent owner/base/request selection and conflict-aware publication use the existing typed collection and durable content implementation

Inspection, review, apply and optional exact-result reopen require separate current native ceremonies and finite grants. The effect approval binds the exact source digest; neither the editor nor a supplied receipt authorizes membership or an effect
Unknown or interrupted apply outcomes remain uncertain without automatic retry, publication success, rollback or workflow-execution claims. Collection editing never moves member files

The protected fixed-module loader retains its 128-KiB source bound. Collection, speech and human-described visual-clarification journeys execute in the original terminal, not in WebKit, and cannot be invoked as generic managed terminal arguments

The text-only model receives no pixels or verified visual semantic mapping. The separate explicit clarification path selects an exact saved sample and requires a fresh exact-artifact Read before any independently reviewed Infer

verification.ordered_native_boundary_fixtures: Read/review/effect/reopen orchestration is tested with ordered observations, not claimed as real PAM, TPM, finite-grant or durable-publication acceptance
